subject: general
question: Which is the brightest star in the night sky visible to us?

options.text: Corner star of the ursa major
Middle star of middle three stars of Orion

solution:
The correct answer is __**Sirius**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sirius is the brightest star in the night sky.
 
• Its name is derived from the Greek word Seirios, meaning 'glowing' or 'scorching'.
 
• Sirius is located in a rather small constellation, Canis Major.
 
• It is also called Alpha Canis Majoris or the Dog Star, it is the brightest star in the night sky.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Orion is one of the constellations and the star Sirius is located near it.
